groups.title: Model A · BASS-II PMMA flame spread

rows.name: QK norm Model A · random forest
Median of six comparison methods
rows.note: Derived reference statistic; not an additional fitted model.

groups.protocol: 18 physical samples / 39 airflow segments; five grouped outer folds. Fixed-candidate results are retrospective diagnostics. No independent external test.
groups.conclusion: Recorded Model A MAE is 12.4% lower than the median of six comparison methods (derived descriptive difference).
groups.caveat: The selection-unbiased nested procedure has MAE 0.01856 mm/s and mean R² -0.444. Fixed-candidate ranking does not replace that result.

groups.title: Model B · Saffire-I luminous ridge

rows.name: QK norm Model B · learned correction

groups.protocol: Six correlated frames from a later time block of one burn; agent-annotated labels. These are frames, not six independent experiments.
groups.conclusion: Binary-median baseline wins; the learned correction does not improve MAE.
groups.caveat: No cross-burn validation. No meaningful population-average model can be inferred from these two baselines.

groups.title: Model C · SAME / SAME-R threshold label

rows.name: QK norm Model C · fixed forest
rows.note: Tie under the released one-fold-SD rule; highest numerical mean.

rows.name: Training-fold material-majority baseline
rows.note: Tied with fixed forest under the released rule.

groups.protocol: 84 primary heating runs / 81 conservative groups; same five saved outer folds. Fixed-forest and material-majority comparisons are post-hoc.
groups.conclusion: Tie: 0.00909 mean advantage for the forest is within the released variability rule; four of five paired differences are zero.
groups.caveat: Fold SD is not a confidence interval. The label is derived ISS scatter ≥2.0 V, not operational alarm truth. Kapton/Teflon positive recall remains weak.

groups.title: WeightSeek-WT4 · language model
groups.protocol: Existing smoke tests establish loading and generation only.
groups.conclusion: Unranked: no measured task-quality comparison is available.
groups.caveat: Successful loading, checksum integrity and generated tokens are not quality scores.

selection_policy: All eligible comparison methods in the frozen recorded evaluations are shown. Median uses all six Model A alternatives, excluding ours and the nested-selection procedure. No competitor was chosen to guarantee a win. There is no defensible global average across these different tasks.
